title: Frequently asked questions - Gemini Notebook Help

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook's current limit is 500,000 words per source for sources.
facts.quote: The current limit is 500,000 words per source or up to 200MB for local uploads. There’s no page limit.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook's current limit for local uploaded sources is 200MB.
facts.quote: The current limit is 500,000 words per source or up to 200MB for local uploads. There’s no page limit.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook states there is no page limit for sources.
facts.quote: The current limit is 500,000 words per source or up to 200MB for local uploads. There’s no page limit.

facts.fact: Sources are rejected from Gemini Notebook if the original PDF is copy-protected.
facts.quote: Your original PDF file is copy-protected.

facts.fact: In Gemini Notebook, notes are used in prompts only when the user specifically selects them.
facts.quote: **Notes:** Only when you specifically select it.

facts.fact: In Gemini Notebook, sources are always used in prompts, either as the entire set or as a selected subset.
facts.quote: **Sources:** Always used in either the entire set or the subset you select.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook uses conversation history to generate responses.
Gemini Notebook states that it will never share user data.
facts.quote: Your data will never be shared by Gemini Notebook.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook states that deleted notes cannot currently be recovered.
facts.quote: Unfortunately, there's currently no way to recover deleted notes.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook states that duplicating a notebook is not yet supported.
Gemini Notebook is available in 180+ regions where the Gemini app is available, per Google's help page.
facts.quote: Check if your country is supported in the [180+ regions where Gemini app is available]

facts.fact: Users must verify their age in their Google Account before accessing Gemini Notebook.
facts.quote: Before you access Gemini Notebook, make sure you verify your age in your Google Account.

facts.fact: If a source's content is too short, Gemini Notebook references the entire document rather than individual cited text.
facts.quote: If your source content is too short, Gemini Notebook references the entire document without a cited individual text from your source.

facts.fact: A notebook's share-menu icon is a lock when private, a shared icon when shared with individual users, and a globe when publicly shared.
facts.quote: It changes to the shared icon when the notebook is shared individually with users, and a globe icon when the notebook is publicly shared.
